== About me

I'm Tyrone Marhguy, a Computer Engineering student at the University of Pennsylvania. I work on processors, hardware, and the software that runs on them.

=== Hardware projects

My https://www.tmarhguy.com/projects/#hardware-projects-title[hardware projects] include the Tomato computer, Pineapple GPU, processor designs, and digital circuits.

=== Software and systems

My https://www.tmarhguy.com/projects/#software-projects-title[software projects] include SeaLion, FramePort, Lobster, and FigDB.

=== Open-source contributions

See my https://www.tmarhguy.com/projects/#open-source-title[open-source work] for contributions to LibreLane, OpenROAD, Verilator, and OpenFPGA.

=== More about my work

My https://www.tmarhguy.com/[website] has project details, engineering notes, and background.
